execution.raw_text:
{
  "up": "Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism
Join molecule_dictionary m_parent on m_parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5498743'
Join molecule_hierarchy mh on mh.parent_molregno = m_parent.molregno
Join molecule_dictionary m_child on m_child.molregno = mh.molregno
Left Join compound_records r on r.molregno = m_child.molregno
Left Join docs d on d.doc_id = r.doc_id
Left Join activities a on a.record_id = r.record_id and a.standard_type = 'IC50' and a.standard_relation = '='
Left Join assays ass on ass.assay_id = a.assay_id
Left Join target_dictionary t on t.tid = ass.tid
Left Join compound_structures cs on cs.molregno = m_child.molregno
Filter ass.assay_organism = 'A549' and t.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL392'
Return compound_chembl_id as compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism
Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism"
}
